data.narrative:
Re:Build Manufacturing is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company founded by Miles Arnone, Jeff Wilke, Anthony Manzo, and Michael Foley, having raised $545M to date. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of nine comparable companies—eight private (including Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Walden Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public entity—operating in the same sector at series A through series B stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $545M total raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, yields $1.1B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector comparables at comparable or adjacent stages produced a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $2.0B. The peer set reflects meaningful dispersion: Walden Robotics valued at $1.1B (seed stage), Humanoid at $1.4B (Series A), and Generalist AI at $2.0B (Series B).

Triangulation of these methods supports a valuation range of $926M to $1.9B, with a midpoint of $1.4B. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables establish the upper range. Key uncertainties include Re:Build's relative product maturity versus the peer cohort and the stage heterogeneity within the comparable set, which spans seed to Series B. Revenue multiples or customer traction data would sharpen this range materially.
